speaker: R
text: Our house blinks at our neighbor every night to keep him away.

speaker: R
text: Dad always rushes home before nine, even from the middle of the grocery store.

speaker: R
text: At nine, Mr. Bell blinks his porch light three times and watches our window.

speaker: R
text: I thought they were planning something.

speaker: R
text: Then Dad hurt his knee and fell asleep on the couch.

speaker: R
text: Nine o'clock came, and our porch stayed dark.

speaker: R
text: I waved from behind the curtain, but he couldn't see me.

speaker: R
text: He stood there in his slippers, staring at our window.

speaker: R
text: I didn't know whether to wake Dad or pretend nobody was home.

speaker: R
text: Then he grabbed his coat and hurried across the street.

speaker: R
text: I opened the door before he could knock.

speaker: R
text: He wasn't angry about the light.

speaker: R
text: He was scared something had happened to Dad.

speaker: R
text: Their secret code meant someone would always come.

speaker: R
text: Tonight, I took Dad's turn at the switch.

speaker: R
text: Mr. Bell went home knowing we were safe inside.
